description.value: A Blenz Coffee franchise tucked into the lower level of Building B at Vancouver Community College's Broadway campus, serving premium espresso drinks prepared by expert baristas with latte art. Blenz is a BC-based specialty coffee chain emphasising individually crafted beverages, making this a convenient urban stop for cyclists near the 7th Ave and Glen Drive intersection in East Vancouver.
